description: PERRY FILES BILL TO ADJUST PLAYOFF SYSTEM LUBBOCK, TX – Today, Senator Charles Perry filed SB 237 to limit the number of teams advancing to the playoffs from each University Interscholastic League (UIL) district to two teams. “Current UIL rules allow 50%-74% of football teams to make the playoffs
title: Press Release: Perry Files Bill to Adjust Playoff System — Elect Charles Perry
